issue_context.title: 500 error while upgrade from 1.6.x to 1.21.7 (Render failed, failed to render template: user/dashboard/dashboard, error: template error: builtin(bindata):user/dashboard/feeds:107:19)
issue_context.body:
### Description

After upgrading from 1.6.x to 1.21.7, this error appears on my Index page

```
Render failed, failed to render template: user/dashboard/dashboard, error: template error: builtin(bindata):user/dashboard/feeds:107:19 : executing "user/dashboard/feeds" at <index .GetIssueInfos 1>: error calling index: reflect: slice index out of range
----------------------------------------------------------------------
					{{$comment := index .GetIssueInfos 1}}
					              ^
```


### Gitea Version

1.21.7

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

No

### Log Gist

_No response_

### Screenshots

![Screenshot_20240306_153025](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/864544/a087abcf-3f27-4717-84a2-0d8001d2418e)


### Git Version

2.40.1

### Operating System

Docker with unraid 6.12.4

### How are you running Gitea?

Docker with unraid 6.12.4

### Database

SQLite
comments:
You could bypass the error by truncating (delete all) your "action" table (or backup it first before emptying it)

(update: it is safe to truncate the action table, because it only saves the "activities")

review_comments:
Do we know in 2 years why that is needed? The whole delimiter concept is fragile because the values are not just numbers but user provided text which can contain the delimiter:
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/a2b0fb1a64b0794b808a013089758a49f56d8915/services/feed/action.go#L232
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/a2b0fb1a64b0794b808a013089758a49f56d8915/services/feed/action.go#L278
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/a2b0fb1a64b0794b808a013089758a49f56d8915/services/feed/action.go#L310
That field should be json or a struct which can be json serialized by xorm. Here for example it contains json text:
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/a2b0fb1a64b0794b808a013089758a49f56d8915/services/feed/action.go#L344

I totally agree with you, but this patch is done intentionally.

1. The fragile `|` is as old 2014-07 (8dd07c0d Unknwon on 2014-07-26 at 12:24)
    * At that time, only `SplitN(2)`, it is generally safe.
    * #12674 made it worse: `SplitN(3)`  ....
3. This patch fixes the panic, and is easy to backport
I'd like don't show the comment which not have enough data.

> I'd like don't show the comment which not have enough data.

Then it needs a lot of new `{{if}}` blocks in the templates. I don't think it's worth to make it that complex.
